key_insight: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks combine inspectable Reynolds-stress closures with separate estimates of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports uncertainty-aware RANS predictions and transfers learned wake corrections to unseen wind-farm layouts.
method: Learn univariate spline functions within a tensor-basis network for Reynolds-stress anisotropy.
Place variational posteriors on spline coefficients to quantify predictive uncertainty.
Enforce invariance, symmetry and tracelessness through the tensor basis; encourage realisability with soft regularisation.
evidence_signal: A controlled regression benchmark and turbulence applications show calibrated in-distribution predictions, while wind-farm tests propagate posterior uncertainty through the RANS solver.
watch_item: Under geometric extrapolation, epistemic uncertainty increases but still underestimates growing prediction errors.
paper_title: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks for trustworthy Reynolds-stress closures
